Groww shares tumble 3% after $200 million block sale

A block deal involving about 10.07 crore Groww shares was executed. The shares were sold at roughly a 3% discount to the market price, valued at around $200 million. The report said Peak XV Partners and Sequoia Capital were the likely sellers. Following the trade, Groww’s share price fell close to 3% in intraday trading. Jefferies retained a Buy rating on Groww’s parent company, citing upside potential.
